text:
Mina Ortiz: Hey everyone! Mina here — joining today as an Infrastructure SWE on Eng Platform. :wave: First day, excited to be here. Quick setup questions and a couple fun facts: I code in Go, play ultimate frisbee, and bake sourdough on weekends.

devex: Welcome Mina!! :tada: Quick checklist: join #eng, #eng-platform, #oncall (if relevant later), request GCP and Slack access via the HR portal. DM me if you want a 1:1 walkthrough.

Alex Park: Welcome!! If you're setting up SSH, here's the command we use (replace key and host):
```
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 mina@bastion.redwood.internal
```
If you hit permission issues ping me.

Zara Iqbal: Hi Mina :wave: Sticker pack incoming. Also if you want a laptop setup session, I run quick setups at 2pm. Bring coffee.

Mina Ortiz: Thanks y'all! Quick Q: I got the new Mac Mini (M2) — is that fine for local dev, or do folks prefer Linux VMs for some workflows?

Tom Nguyen: M2 is fine for most stuff (dev server + VS Code). For heavy perf tests we use Linux runners, but you can start on mac. If you need Docker buildx for x86 images, let me know.

Marc Li: tagging @Alex Park — Mina, I'll be your onboarding buddy this week. Happy to pair on infra repos and perms. Also FYI, internal CI runs on linux-only runners so you'll want access to the `eng-ci` project.

Mina Ortiz: Awesome, thanks Marc! How do I request access to `eng-ci`? I don't see it in the portal.

hr-bot: Hi Mina — welcome again! Please use this link to request project access and computer perks: https://redwood/hr/onboarding/request. Put "eng-ci" in the project field and include your manager's approval.

ops-bot: Automated note: Mina Ortiz added to new-hires channel at 2254321098. Remember to complete the security training within 7 days.

Alex Park: If you want, I can add you to the `eng-ci` group manually now — need your GitHub handle.

Mina Ortiz: GitHub handle is minao. Thanks everyone — I'll DM Alex and Marc. Looking forward to meeting folks! :smile:

Zara Iqbal: Lunch today? A few of us are heading to the taco truck at noon if you want to join. :)

Mina Ortiz: Count me in!
